ACCOUNTABLE BY DESIGN

Different responsibilities. Visible decisions.

01

Clinical review

A named clinician reviews clinical-equivalence evidence and intended-use restrictions.

02

Purchasing review

A named purchaser reviews contract, supply and purchasing authorization.

03

Coordination

Materials reviewers maintain evidence, ownership and the next action without replacing either decision.

WHEN TO HOLD

Abstention is a useful state.

HOLD

Unreliable mapping

A source unit or item identifier cannot be reconciled.

HOLD

Missing equivalence evidence

A candidate lacks adequate clinical review context.

HOLD

Stale or conflicting evidence

Source freshness or physical quantity is unresolved.

HOLD

Unclear permission

The access or action is outside the agreed scope.

CURRENT PREVIEW BOUNDARY

Know what this site does.

Included

Synthetic examples, reversible local interactions, source dates, fictional owners and visible uncertainty.

Excluded

PHI, live EHR/ERP/portal integrations, clinical recommendations, outbound messages, payment, system writes or physical action.

VALIDATION REQUIRED

Operational trust must be earned.
